$comment: The guides' captures and walkthroughs, recorded from the deployed testnet product by scripts/record-media.mjs and published by scripts/publish-media.mjs (D-227). Alt text and chapter text describe the procedure, which the recorder enforces step by step; a step that fails leaves its clip unpublished.

walkthroughs.name: first-call-demo
walkthroughs.title: A first call in DEMO
walkthroughs.description: Signed out on a phone: the terminal's tour, then UP on BTC and CLOSE, on paper at the live book's price.

chapter.title: Open the terminal
chapter.text: Signed out, the terminal trades on paper: the equity pill reads DEMO.

chapter.title: Skip the tour
chapter.text: Five steps explain the line, UP and DOWN, the value pill, Trail and Close.

chapter.title: Tap UP
chapter.text: A paper call fills at the live book's price.

chapter.title: Watch what it's worth
chapter.text: The pill shows what CLOSE pays now.

chapter.title: Close it
chapter.text: CLOSE sells it back at what the book pays.

walkthroughs.name: proof-reverify
walkthroughs.title: Re-verify a settled Window
walkthroughs.description: From the leaderboard to a trader's record to a settled Window's proof, then the closing print re-verified in the browser against the chain.

chapter.title: Open the leaderboard
chapter.text: Records ranked from their settled calls.

chapter.title: Open a record
chapter.text: Each row links its calls and their proofs.

chapter.title: Open a proof
chapter.text: The verdict, the settlement transaction and both signed prints.

chapter.title: Re-verify
chapter.text: The browser reads the recording transaction and asks the verifier contract again.
